name_zh: 杜南/瑞士/红十字/日内瓦公约/人道/诺贝尔/索尔费里诺/慈善
description_zh: 亨利·杜南（1828-1910），瑞士慈善家，红十字会国际委员会（ICRC）创始人，日内瓦公约的主要推动者，1859年索尔费里诺战役目击者，撰写《索尔费里诺回忆录》发起创立红十字会，诺贝尔和平奖获得者，其人道主义思想和红十字会组织对国际人道主义法产生深远影响。
description_en: Henri Dunant (1828-1910), Swiss philanthropist, founder of International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), main promoter of Geneva Convention, eyewitness of Solferino Battle in 1859, wrote "Memoirs of Solferino" to initiate founding of Red Cross, Nobel Peace Prize winner, his humanitarian thinking and Red Cross organization profoundly influenced international humanitarian law.
reason_zh: 杜南是红十字会国际委员会的创始人，日内瓦公约的主要推动者，其人道主义思想和实践对国际人道主义法和红十字会体系的建立产生深远影响。
reason_en: Dunant was founder of International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), main promoter of Geneva Convention, his humanitarian thinking and practice profoundly influenced international humanitarian law and Red Cross system.
expected_zh: 创立红十字会国际委员会，推动日内瓦公约签订，其人道主义思想和实践对国际人道主义法和红十字会体系的建立产生深远影响。
expected_en: Established International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), promoted Geneva Convention, his humanitarian thinking and practice profoundly influenced international humanitarian law and Red Cross system.
